questions.question: She decided _____ a new language.
questions.explanation_ar: يأتي الفعل بصيغة to + الفعل الأساسي بعد decide.

questions.question: He avoids _____ too much sugar.
questions.explanation_ar: يأتي الفعل مع ing بعد avoid.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: They enjoy to swim in the sea.
questions.correct_answer: They enjoy swimming in the sea.
questions.explanation_ar: يأتي الفعل مع ing بعد enjoy، لذلك نقول enjoy swimming.

questions.question: The homework must _____ before Monday.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد must في المبني للمجهول نستخدم be ثم التصريف الثالث.

questions.question: You _____ be tired after such a long journey.
questions.explanation_ar: يمكن استخدام must للتعبير عن استنتاج قوي بناءً على دليل.

questions.question: When we arrived, the film _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي التام للحدث الذي وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي.

questions.question: She had _____ her lunch before the lesson began. (finish)
questions.explanation_ar: يتكون الماضي التام من had + التصريف الثالث للفعل.

questions.question: I could not enter the house because I _____ my key.
questions.explanation_ar: فقدان المفتاح حدث قبل عدم القدرة على دخول المنزل، لذلك نستخدم الماضي التام.

questions.question: I wish I _____ taller.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم wish مع الماضي البسيط للتعبير عن أمنية تتعلق بالحاضر، ويشيع استخدام were مع جميع الضمائر في هذا التركيب.

questions.question: The meeting starts _____ 9:30 a.m.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم at مع الوقت المحدد مثل 9:30 a.m.

questions.question: My birthday is _____ November.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم in مع الأشهر والفصول والسنوات.

questions.question: The picture is hanging _____ the wall.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم on عندما يكون الشيء مثبتًا أو موجودًا على سطح.

questions.question: Please turn _____ the lights before leaving the room.
questions.explanation_ar: Turn off تعني إطفاء الجهاز أو الضوء.

questions.question: Please look _____ this word in the dictionary.
questions.explanation_ar: Look up تعني يبحث عن معلومة أو كلمة في مرجع.

questions.question: Match each academic word with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: تُستخدم هذه الأفعال والمفردات في الأسئلة المدرسية والأنشطة التي تتطلب التفكير والتحليل.

questions.question: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
questions.explanation_ar: تمتص الجذور الماء والأملاح المعدنية من التربة.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation_ar: يُعرف كوكب Mars باسم الكوكب الأحمر بسبب مظهره المحمر.

questions.question: Solar panels use energy from the _____.
questions.explanation_ar: تستخدم الألواح الشمسية طاقة الشمس لإنتاج الكهرباء.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The instructions were very _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج إلى صفة بعد were لوصف التعليمات، والكلمة المناسبة helpful.

questions.question: A person who invents something is an _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Inventor تعني مخترع، وهي اسم الشخص الذي يقوم بالاختراع.

questions.passage: Our class visited a history museum on Tuesday. Before the visit, our teacher had explained the rules and divided us into small groups. At the museum, we saw old tools, traditional clothes, and photographs. A guide told us how people lived many years ago. I was especially interested in the old fishing equipment because my grandfather used similar tools. After the visit, we wrote a short report about what we had learned.
questions.question: What had the teacher done before the visit?
options: Explained the rules and divided the students into groups
questions.correct_answer: Explained the rules and divided the students into groups
questions.explanation_ar: يوضح النص أن المعلم شرح القواعد وقسّم الطلاب إلى مجموعات قبل الزيارة.

questions.passage: Our class visited a history museum on Tuesday. Before the visit, our teacher had explained the rules and divided us into small groups. At the museum, we saw old tools, traditional clothes, and photographs. A guide told us how people lived many years ago. I was especially interested in the old fishing equipment because my grandfather used similar tools. After the visit, we wrote a short report about what we had learned.
questions.question: Why was the writer interested in the old fishing equipment?
options: Because the grandfather used similar tools
Because the writer wanted to buy a boat
Because the guide gave it as a gift
Because it was made of gold
questions.correct_answer: Because the grandfather used similar tools
questions.explanation_ar: اهتم الكاتب بأدوات الصيد القديمة لأن جده كان يستخدم أدوات مشابهة.

questions.passage: Our class visited a history museum on Tuesday. Before the visit, our teacher had explained the rules and divided us into small groups. At the museum, we saw old tools, traditional clothes, and photographs. A guide told us how people lived many years ago. I was especially interested in the old fishing equipment because my grandfather used similar tools. After the visit, we wrote a short report about what we had learned.
questions.question: What did the students do after the visit?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد الزيارة كتب الطلاب تقريرًا قصيرًا عمّا تعلموه.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order: had / before / left / the train / we / arrived
questions.correct_answer: The train had left before we arrived.
questions.explanation_ar: القطار غادر قبل وصولنا؛ لذلك نستخدم الماضي التام had left للحدث الأسبق.

questions.question: Do you think children should learn about science through experiments? Write four or five sentences explaining your opinion.

criteria: Use linking words such as because, also, or so.
rubric.sample_answer: I think children should learn science through experiments. Experiments make lessons interesting. Students can see how things work. They can ask questions and discover new ideas. This helps them remember what they learn.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب رأيك بوضوح، واذكر سببين على الأقل، واستخدم كلمات الربط لتوضيح أفكارك.
